title: Butterfly Beetle Beat
hook: Legs, wings, antennae tell us which group we see.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat after cue, then bright answer
visualStyle: vivid 3D butterfly-and-beetle storybook, flower colors, shiny but simple insect forms, segmentation-friendly spacing

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child classifying tiny animals by visible anatomy
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written classification facts with non-insect exceptions explicit
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: classification cue -> recall beat -> target -> count/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a close-up kalimba pluck with one soft bell sparkle after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a close-up kalimba pluck with one soft bell sparkle after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn Butterfly Beetle Beat into a classification close-up: six-legged insects are compared with an eight-legged orb-weaver and a many-legged terrestrial crustacean, so 'tiny creature' never collapses into 'insect'.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A magnified field guide checks legs, wings, antennae and life stage before naming the group.
semanticArc: finish with wing and metamorphosis diversity
